title: Code for: Odd denominators in the Lonely Runner spectrum for six speeds
description: Exact verification code for the paper "Odd denominators in the Lonely Runner spectrum for six speeds" (F. Cordella, 2026): classification of the critical two-dimensional subtori of (R/Z)^6 and (R/Z)^5, exact maximum-loneliness kernel in C, complete Jain-Kravitz sector analysis of the subtorus U_C with explicit thresholds, one-very-fast-runner checks, and exhaustive searches for four to eight speeds. run_all.sh reproduces every number quoted in the paper in about twenty minutes on two cores. Requirements: Python 3 (numpy optional) and a C99 compiler with OpenMP.
